select b.IND_NAME indName, b.IND_TYPE indType, a.UUID uuid, a.TRADE_ID tradeId, a.TRADE_TYPE tradeType, a.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, a.IND_ID indId, a.ASSET_CODE assetCode, a.SUP_DATE supDate, a.SUP_VAL supVal, a.SUP_STAT supStat, a.UNITE_SUP_STAT uniteSupStat, a.WARN_COND warnCond, a.APPROVE_COND approveCond, a.FOUL_COND foulCond, a.CONCLUSION conclusion, a.OLD_SUP_VAL oldSupVal, a.SUP_TREND supTrend from RSK_ISUP_TRIAL a, RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR b where TRADE_ID = #{eventId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.IND_ID = b.IND_ID and a.SEQ_NO = #{uuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and ASSET_CODE = #{assetCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select DISTINCT t2.TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, t2.ASSET_CODE ASSET_CODE, t1.CONCLUSION CONCLUSION, t2.SEQ_NO SEQ_NO, t1.UPDATE_TIME from RSK_ISUP_TRIAL_CLS t1 LEFT JOIN RSK_ISUP_TRIAL t2 ON t1.SEQ_NO = t2.SEQ_NO AND t1.TRADE_ID = t2.TRADE_ID where t2.TRADE_ID = #{eventId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY t1.UPDATE_TIME DESC
